section.title: 41.24 Key/MIDI Map Mode and the Computer MIDI Keyboard

mappings.note: Live Cmd+M enters global MIDI Map Mode. Ardour uses per-control MIDI learn (BindingProxy / TriggerBox begin_midi_learn) without a session-wide MIDI map mode; profile Primary-m cuts monitor section.

evidence.reference: Search scope: global MIDI map mode. Terms: MIDI Map, midi learn mode, BindingProxy, begin_midi_learn. Subsystems: BindingProxy, TriggerBox MIDI learn, Controllable. Per-control learn only; no global map mode action. ../ardour@9.7:gtk2_ardour/trigger_ui.cc:431-447;libs/ardour/triggerbox.cc:4870-4878

mappings.note: Live Cmd+K enters Key Map Mode for assigning computer-keyboard shortcuts to controls. Ardour has no Live-style key-map mode; profile Primary-k trims region to next.

evidence.reference: Search scope: key map mode. Terms: key map, MIDI map keyboard, learn keybinding UI. Subsystems: ActionManager bindings, BindingProxy. No global key-map mode. ../ardour@9.7:gtk2_ardour/ardour_ui_ed.cc

mappings.note: Live M toggles the Computer MIDI Keyboard overlay. Ardour toggles the Virtual Keyboard window; keys play MIDI when that window handles input, not as a global Live-style keyboard layer over the whole UI.
Live X/Z shift computer-MIDI octave. Ardour Virtual Keyboard adjusts octave via UI controls and arrow keys (tooltip), not bindable X/Z actions. Alternate Z in note.

evidence.reference: Search scope: virtual keyboard octave shortcuts X/Z. Terms: piano_octave_key, SwitchOctave. Subsystems: VirtualKeyboardWindow. UI octave controls exist; no X/Z actions. ../ardour@9.7:gtk2_ardour/virtual_keyboard_window.cc:213-225

mappings.note: Live C/V adjust computer-MIDI velocity. Ardour exposes velocity via Virtual Keyboard UI/scroll, not C/V actions. Alternate V in note.

evidence.reference: Search scope: virtual keyboard velocity C/V. Terms: piano_velocity. Subsystems: VirtualKeyboardWindow. ../ardour@9.7:gtk2_ardour/virtual_keyboard_window.cc:212-219
profile/keybindings/macos/ardour.keys: Editor c -> Editor/track-record-enable-toggle; Editor v -> Region/set-region-sync-position

mappings.note: Live Shift+letter runs single-letter shortcuts while Computer MIDI Keyboard is active. Ardour virtual keyboard either propagates keys to the window or to ActionManager without a Shift-bypass computer-MIDI layer; representative token Tertiary-a, other letters in note.

evidence.reference: Search scope: Shift bypass virtual MIDI keyboard for letter shortcuts. Terms: virtual_keyboard propagate_key_event, Tertiary letter. Subsystems: ardour_ui_keys virtual keyboard path. ../ardour@9.7:gtk2_ardour/ardour_ui_keys.cc:63-64
